SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.CUSTOMER_ID, o.NET_AMOUNT FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT ORDER_ID AS id, NET_AMOUNT AS amount FROM SALES_ORDERS
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.STATUS = 'OPEN'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CLIENT = '100' AND o.NET_AMOUNT > 1000
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, c.NAME FROM SALES_ORDERS o INNER JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, c.NAME FROM SALES_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, c.NAME, i.MATERIAL FROM SALES_ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID

SELECT o.ORDER_ID, c.NAME, i.MATERIAL, m.DESCRIPTION FROM SALES_ORDERS o INNER JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN MATERIALS m ON m.MATERIAL = i.MATERIAL
SELECT c.REGION, SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS total FROM SALES_ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.REGION
SELECT c.REGION, COUNT(*) AS n FROM CUSTOMERS c GROUP BY c.REGION
SELECT COUNT(1) AS n FROM SALES_ORDERS
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.CUSTOMER_ID) AS customers FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT AVG(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS avg_amount, MIN(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS min_amount, MAX(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS max_amount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS total FROM SALES_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID HAVING SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) > 5000
SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM SALES_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.NET_AMOUNT FROM SALES_ORDERS o ORDER BY o.NET_AMOUNT DESC, o.ORDER_ID ASC
SELECT DISTINCT o.STATUS FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'BLOCKED', 'PARTIAL')
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID IN (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.REGION = 'EMEA')
SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.NAME FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID AND o.NET_AMOUNT > 100)
SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.NAME FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID)
SELECT t.CUSTOMER_ID, t.total FROM (SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS total FROM SALES_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID) t WHERE t.total > 1000
SELECT c.NAME, t.n FROM CUSTOMERS c JOIN (SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM SALES_ORDERS o GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID) t ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID IN (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CUSTOMER_FLAGS f WHERE f.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID))
SELECT CAST(o.NET_AMOUNT AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS amount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT CAST(o.ORDER_ID AS VARCHAR(20)) AS id FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT CAST(o.QTY AS INTEGER) AS qty FROM ORDER_ITEMS o
SELECT COALESCE(c.NAME, 'unknown') AS name FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT NULLIF(o.DISCOUNT, 0) AS discount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT CASE WHEN o.NET_AMOUNT > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN o.NET_AMOUNT > 1000 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'LOW' END AS band FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT CASE o.STATUS WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_open FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.STATUS = 'OPEN' THEN o.NET_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS open_amount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT UPPER(c.NAME) AS name, LOWER(c.CITY) AS city FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT LENGTH(c.NAME) AS len, TRIM(c.NAME) AS trimmed FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT SUBSTRING(c.NAME, 1, 3) AS prefix FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT CONCAT(c.NAME, c.CITY) AS label FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT c.NAME || ' - ' || c.CITY AS label FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT REPLACE(c.PHONE, '-', '') AS phone FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT ROUND(o.NET_AMOUNT, 2) AS amount, ABS(o.DISCOUNT) AS discount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT YEAR(o.CREATED_AT) AS y, MONTH(o.CREATED_AT) AS m, SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS total FROM SALES_ORDERS o GROUP BY YEAR(o.CREATED_AT), MONTH(o.CREATED_AT)
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CREATED_AT >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -30)
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CREATED_AT BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, DAYS_BETWEEN(o.CREATED_AT, o.DELIVERED_AT) AS days FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE('2024-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT "o"."ORDER_ID", "o"."NET_AMOUNT" FROM "SALES_ORDERS" "o" WHERE "o"."STATUS" = 'OPEN'
SELECT "ORDER_ID" AS "Order Id" FROM "SALES_ORDERS"
SELECT c.NAME FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.NAME LIKE 'AC%' AND c.CITY IS NOT NULL
SELECT c.NAME FROM CUSTOMERS c WHERE c.DELETED_AT IS NULL OR c.ACTIVE = 1
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE NOT (o.STATUS = 'CLOSED') AND (o.NET_AMOUNT * 1.19) > 100
SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.NET_AMOUNT - o.DISCOUNT AS net FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.NET_AMOUNT / 2 > 10 AND MOD(o.QTY, 2) = 0
SELECT x.CUSTOMER_ID FROM (SELECT y.CUSTOMER_ID FROM (SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o) y) x
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.NET_AMOUNT > (SELECT AVG(p.NET_AMOUNT) FROM SALES_ORDERS p)
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(o.NET_AMOUNT) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS n FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) > 1 ORDER BY total DESC
select o.order_id from sales_orders o where o.status = 'OPEN'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.COMMENT_TEXT = 'it''s fine'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.NOTE = 'a;b' AND o.TAG <> 'x--y'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE o.CUSTOMER_ID = 'ÁLVARO'
SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM SALES_ORDERS o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.CREATED_AT) = 2024
SELECT IFNULL(o.DISCOUNT, 0) AS discount FROM SALES_ORDERS o
SELECT LEFT(c.NAME, 2) AS a, RIGHT(c.NAME, 2) AS b FROM CUSTOMERS c
SELECT a FROM T;
